name: Hero 2 (stocky knight)
description: a stocky, broad-shouldered knight, a little shorter than average with a thick torso, short sturdy legs and big gauntleted hands; full plate armour of dark gunmetal steel with a slight warm sheen; a rounded dome great helm with a single horizontal visor slit and a raised central ridge, no face visible; large rounded pauldrons, a barrel-shaped breastplate, plate gauntlets, greaves and broad sabatons; a wide red-brown leather belt with a dark iron buckle; a short dark-grey chainmail skirt to mid-thigh with a plain crimson cloth tabard panel hanging front and back to just above the knees; a short crimson cloth half-cape over both shoulders, ending at the middle of the back with a clean, slightly worn hem; both hands empty, no weapon, no shield

references.note: rounded pauldrons under a short cape, crimson front panel
stockiest: big round pauldrons over the cape, clenched fists
pointed pauldrons, high gorget collar, red belt
